author: Ez_claps
quote: This GTA represents everything that is wrong with the modern gaming industry. People play video games to have fun, I do not need to be constantly reminded of the redundancy of chores in every day life when I sit down to play. Clicking one button the entire time and having a cinematic for every monotonous task like grabbing groceries is boring and annoying. Furthermore, there is very limited player freedom in this iteration making the experience incredibly frustrating. The gameplay is simply not there, this is a poorly written movie masking itself as a video game. Which is awful when you see that not only is the story hot garbage and poorly written slop, but the game itself is terribly designed. There is a 30 fps cap that frequently dips low causing stuttering and heavy screen tear. Glitches like falling through the map and morphing through objects happen at alarmingly high rates. This is absolutely unacceptable for a two-billion dollar game that was supposedly 13 years in the making. Outside of the improved graphics, I struggle to find anything positive about the experience of this GTA. I implore everyone to think about just how good it could have been if the consumer base was more frugal with their money, and the industry media itself did not try to justify and defend this mediocrity. What a shame.
